title: 软银CDS飙升：债券流动性收紧，市场参与者能否顺利退出？
speaker: Monica Schell

segments.en: So, you know, in Asia, for example, you know, we don't have as much trading in single-name CDS.
segments.zh: 在亚洲，单一名称CDS的交易量并不大。

segments.en: However, you know, the CDS of soft bank certainly is indicative and if you look at the bonds, we have the additional impact of not only credit spread widening generally, but also illiquidity of bonds when, I mean, soft bank is actually a big curve.
segments.zh: 但软银的CDS确实有指示意义，而且债券方面，除了信用利差普遍走阔，还有流动性不足的问题——软银的债券曲线很长。

segments.en: However, if dealers have their full, you're going to have less liquidity in the bid ask and that could have in turn an impact on investors who want to rush for the exit.
segments.zh: 如果交易商仓位已满，买卖价差流动性就会降低，进而影响急于退出的投资者。

segments.en: So, what you see is that the intra-day or even intra-week volatility of soft bank bonds are, you know, big enough that you're always going to get people who come in to short it as a function of beta and that is probably the biggest expression of the AI sort of trade up and down in Asia credit market.
segments.zh: 所以软银债券的日内甚至周内波动很大，总有人基于贝塔值来做空，这可能是亚洲信用市场中AI交易起伏的最大体现。
